notes: High-performance data center in Rahlstedter Gewerbegebiet Victoriapark opened May 2025; built by Green Datahub Holding with AKQUINET for ~70-80 M EUR; 700+ server racks on 2,350 sqm; PV roof, waste-heat reuse for neighbouring buildings. AKQUINET also operates DCs in Alsterdorf (Hamburg), Norderstedt and Itzehoe.
